parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used for the next query.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of resource N. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource. Only scaling groups are supported. Set the value to scalinggroup.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ess list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type scalinggroup --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --resource-id asg-bp17xb4x1vr29lgt0000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ess ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'asg-bp17xb4x1vr29lgt0000' --Tag.1.Key TestKey --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --Tag.1.Value TestValue --ResourceType scalinggroup --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
